lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce8U4Al4 (reduced formula Ce2UAl) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 14 neighbors and Ce centers with 20 neighbors, while U centers have 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Al 14-vertex polyhedra, and corner/face sharing between Al and Ce polyhedra.
